items.name: theme
items.title: ikas Theme
items.description: Light-first neutral theme tokens: surfaces, six-color palette, status colors, radius and elevation. Install first.

[data-anim].transition: rotate 450ms var(--ease-spring), translate 300ms var(--ease-spring), scale 300ms var(--ease-spring)

theme.shadow-solid: inset 0 1px 0 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.2), inset 0 -1px 0 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.12), 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, var(--c) 86%, black), 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 3px 10px -3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--c) 55%, transparent)
theme.shadow-solid-hover: inset 0 1px 0 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.24), inset 0 -1px 0 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.12), 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, var(--c) 86%, black), 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 5px 16px -4px color-mix(in oklab, var(--c) 70%, transparent)
theme.shadow-pressed: inset 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.22), 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, var(--c) 86%, black)
